limits: One-second physical-RAM observations cannot bound unsampled peaks.
RSS, CUDA allocations and file cache are not added to physical RAM.
Snapshot disk bytes are SSD, not additional resident RAM.
Save wall time includes waiting for model mutex; restore wall time starts under that mutex. End-to-end TTFT includes both waits.
External startup/shutdown windows include direct-I/O preflight and cache teardown; ready polling has one-second granularity.
GPU memcpy/internal pageable staging is included in host RAM observations; no isolated GPU section timing was collected.
Process RAM attribution includes exact server binary paths from the SHA-bound plan, including the baseline named parent. Raw samples unchanged.
Pool byte fields are cumulative resident SSD bytes, not per-save bytes.
Sum of separate pool maxima is a bound, not a simultaneous observation.
Prefix save wall time starts under model mutex and is in HTTP latency.
No isolated GPU-duration or allocation-delta measurement.
Fixed IO preparation precedes the stage sampler: no sampled RAM peak for it. Source allocates an 8 MiB mmap plus a temporary 8 MiB payload, in addition to Python and filesystem memory.
